parameters.query:
WITH
input_data AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(btrim($1::text), '') AS business_name,
    NULLIF(btrim($2::text), '') AS city,
    NULLIF(btrim($3::text), '') AS province,
    NULLIF(btrim($4::text), '') AS address,
    CASE WHEN lower(btrim(coalesce($5::text,''))) IN ('','n/a','na','none','null','unknown','-','—') THEN NULL ELSE btrim($5::text) END AS phone,
    CASE WHEN lower(btrim(coalesce($6::text,''))) IN ('','n/a','na','none','null','unknown','-','—') THEN NULL ELSE btrim($6::text) END AS website,
    CASE WHEN lower(btrim(coalesce($7::text,''))) IN ('','n/a','na','none','null','unknown','-','—') THEN NULL ELSE lower(btrim($7::text)) END AS domain,
    CASE WHEN lower(btrim(coalesce($8::text,''))) IN ('','n/a','na','none','null','unknown','-','—') THEN NULL ELSE btrim($8::text) END AS google_maps_url,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim($9::text),'') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE $9::numeric END AS latitude,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim($10::text),'') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE $10::numeric END AS longitude,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim($11::text),'') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE $11::numeric END AS rating,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim($12::text),'') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE greatest(0,$12::integer) END AS review_count,
    NULLIF(btrim($13::text),'') AS category,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($14::text),''),'unknown') AS search_keyword,
    CASE WHEN $16 IS NULL OR btrim($16::text)='' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE $16::jsonb END AS social_profiles,
    CASE WHEN $17 IS NULL OR btrim($17::text)='' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE $17::jsonb END AS website_signals,
    least(100,greatest(0,COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($18::text),'')::integer,0))) AS ai_score,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($19::text),''),'unrated') AS ai_grade,
    NULLIF(btrim($20::text),'') AS ai_qualification,
    NULLIF(btrim($21::text),'') AS ai_nurture_strategy,
    CASE WHEN $22 IS NULL OR btrim($22::text)='' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE $22::jsonb END AS ai_analysis,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($23::text),'')::timestamptz,now()) AS source_retrieved_at,
    CASE WHEN lower(coalesce($25::text,'false')) IN ('true','1','yes','y') THEN true ELSE false END AS whatsapp_capable,
    CASE WHEN lower(coalesce($26::text,'false')) IN ('true','1','yes','y') THEN true ELSE false END AS whatsapp_confirmed,
    NULLIF(btrim($28::text),'') AS conversion_tier,
    NULLIF(btrim($29::text),'') AS meta_crm_fit,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim($30::text),'') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE $30::integer END AS social_activity_score
),
raw_business_emails AS (
  SELECT lower(btrim(value)) AS email
  FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
    CASE WHEN $15 IS NULL OR btrim($15::text)='' OR jsonb_typeof($15::jsonb) <> 'array' THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE $15::jsonb END
  ) AS x(value)
),
valid_business_emails AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT email
  FROM raw_business_emails
  WHERE email IS NOT NULL
    AND email <> ''
    AND length(email) <= 254
    AND email ~ '^[a-z0-9.!#$%&''*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*\.[a-z]{2,63}$'
    AND email !~ '\.\.'
    AND email !~* '@[^@]+\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|svg|ico|css|js|woff2?|ttf|eot|pdf|zip)$'
),
business_email_array AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(email ORDER BY email),ARRAY[]::text[]) AS emails
  FROM valid_business_emails
),
raw_whatsapp_numbers AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(btrim(value),'') AS wa_number
  FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
    CASE WHEN $27 IS NULL OR btrim($27::text)='' OR jsonb_typeof($27::jsonb) <> 'array' THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE $27::jsonb END
  ) AS x(value)
),
whatsapp_number_array AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT wa_number ORDER BY wa_number),ARRAY[]::text[]) AS whatsapp_numbers
  FROM raw_whatsapp_numbers WHERE wa_number IS NOT NULL
),
lead AS (
  INSERT INTO pakistan_real_estate_leads (
    business_name,city,province,address,phone,website,domain,google_maps_url,
    latitude,longitude,rating,review_count,category,search_keyword,emails,
    social_profiles,website_signals,ai_score,ai_grade,ai_qualification,
    ai_nurture_strategy,ai_analysis,source_retrieved_at,last_seen_at,
    whatsapp_capable,whatsapp_confirmed,whatsapp_numbers,conversion_tier,
    meta_crm_fit,social_activity_score
  )
  SELECT
    i.business_name,i.city,i.province,i.address,i.phone,i.website,i.domain,i.google_maps_url,
    i.latitude,i.longitude,i.rating,i.review_count,i.category,i.search_keyword,e.emails,
    i.social_profiles,i.website_signals,i.ai_score,i.ai_grade,i.ai_qualification,
    i.ai_nurture_strategy,i.ai_analysis,i.source_retrieved_at,now(),
    i.whatsapp_capable,i.whatsapp_confirmed,w.whatsapp_numbers,i.conversion_tier,
    i.meta_crm_fit,i.social_activity_score
  FROM input_data i CROSS JOIN business_email_array e CROSS JOIN whatsapp_number_array w
  WHERE i.business_name IS NOT NULL
    AND i.city IS NOT NULL
    AND (i.google_maps_url IS NOT NULL OR i.domain IS NOT NULL OR i.phone IS NOT NULL OR i.website IS NOT NULL)
  ON CONFLICT (business_key) DO UPDATE SET
    province=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.province,pakistan_real_estate_leads.province),
    address=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.address,pakistan_real_estate_leads.address),
    phone=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone,pakistan_real_estate_leads.phone),
    website=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.website,pakistan_real_estate_leads.website),
    domain=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.domain,pakistan_real_estate_leads.domain),
    google_maps_url=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.google_maps_url,pakistan_real_estate_leads.google_maps_url),
    latitude=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.latitude,pakistan_real_estate_leads.latitude),
    longitude=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.longitude,pakistan_real_estate_leads.longitude),
    rating=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.rating,pakistan_real_estate_leads.rating),
    review_count=greatest(EXCLUDED.review_count,pakistan_real_estate_leads.review_count),
    category=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.category,pakistan_real_estate_leads.category),
    search_keyword=EXCLUDED.search_keyword,
    emails=(
      SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT e ORDER BY e),ARRAY[]::text[])
      FROM unnest(pakistan_real_estate_leads.emails || EXCLUDED.emails) AS u(e)
      WHERE e IS NOT NULL AND e <> ''
    ),
    social_profiles=CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.social_profiles='{}'::jsonb THEN pakistan_real_estate_leads.social_profiles ELSE EXCLUDED.social_profiles END,
    website_signals=CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.website_signals='{}'::jsonb THEN pakistan_real_estate_leads.website_signals ELSE EXCLUDED.website_signals END,
    ai_score=EXCLUDED.ai_score,
    ai_grade=EXCLUDED.ai_grade,
    ai_qualification=EXCLUDED.ai_qualification,
    ai_nurture_strategy=EXCLUDED.ai_nurture_strategy,
    ai_analysis=CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.ai_analysis='{}'::jsonb THEN pakistan_real_estate_leads.ai_analysis ELSE EXCLUDED.ai_analysis END,
    source_retrieved_at=EXCLUDED.source_retrieved_at,
    last_seen_at=now(),
    whatsapp_capable=EXCLUDED.whatsapp_capable,
    whatsapp_confirmed=EXCLUDED.whatsapp_confirmed OR pakistan_real_estate_leads.whatsapp_confirmed,
    whatsapp_numbers=(
      SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT n ORDER BY n),ARRAY[]::text[])
      FROM unnest(pakistan_real_estate_leads.whatsapp_numbers || EXCLUDED.whatsapp_numbers) AS u(n)
      WHERE n IS NOT NULL AND n <> ''
    ),
    conversion_tier=EXCLUDED.conversion_tier,
    meta_crm_fit=EXCLUDED.meta_crm_fit,
    social_activity_score=EXCLUDED.social_activity_score
  RETURNING id,business_name
),
raw_contacts AS (
  SELECT c
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN $24 IS NULL OR btrim($24::text)='' OR jsonb_typeof($24::jsonb) <> 'array' THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE $24::jsonb END
  ) AS x(c)
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(c)='object'
),
clean_contacts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (contact_identity)
    full_name,job_title,authority_level,email,phone,linkedin_url,source_url,confidence,is_decision_maker
  FROM (
    SELECT
      NULLIF(btrim(c->>'full_name'),'') AS full_name,
      NULLIF(btrim(c->>'job_title'),'') AS job_title,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(btrim(c->>'authority_level')),''),'unknown') AS authority_level,
      CASE
        WHEN lower(btrim(coalesce(c->>'email',''))) ~ '^[a-z0-9.!#$%&''*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*\.[a-z]{2,63}$'
         AND lower(btrim(c->>'email')) !~ '\.\.'
         AND lower(btrim(c->>'email')) !~* '@[^@]+\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|svg|ico|css|js|woff2?|ttf|eot|pdf|zip)$'
        THEN lower(btrim(c->>'email')) ELSE NULL END AS email,
      CASE WHEN lower(btrim(coalesce(c->>'phone',''))) IN ('','n/a','na','none','null','unknown','-','—') THEN NULL ELSE btrim(c->>'phone') END AS phone,
      NULLIF(btrim(c->>'linkedin_url'),'') AS linkedin_url,
      NULLIF(btrim(c->>'source_url'),'') AS source_url,
      least(100,greatest(0,CASE WHEN coalesce(c->>'confidence','') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (c->>'confidence')::integer ELSE 0 END)) AS confidence,
      lower(coalesce(c->>'is_decision_maker','false')) IN ('true','1','yes','y') AS is_decision_maker,
      lower(coalesce(
        NULLIF(btrim(c->>'email'),''),
        NULLIF(btrim(c->>'linkedin_url'),''),
        CASE WHEN lower(btrim(coalesce(c->>'phone',''))) IN ('','n/a','na','none','null','unknown','-','—') THEN NULL ELSE btrim(c->>'phone') END,
        NULLIF(coalesce(NULLIF(btrim(c->>'full_name'),''),'') || '|' || coalesce(NULLIF(btrim(c->>'job_title'),''),''),'|')
      )) AS contact_identity
    FROM raw_contacts
  ) s
  WHERE contact_identity IS NOT NULL AND contact_identity <> ''
  ORDER BY contact_identity, confidence DESC
),
contacts AS (
  INSERT INTO pakistan_real_estate_contacts (
    lead_id,full_name,job_title,authority_level,email,phone,linkedin_url,source_url,confidence,is_decision_maker
  )
  SELECT
    l.id,c.full_name,c.job_title,c.authority_level,c.email,c.phone,c.linkedin_url,c.source_url,c.confidence,c.is_decision_maker
  FROM lead l CROSS JOIN clean_contacts c
  ON CONFLICT (lead_id,contact_key) DO UPDATE SET
    full_name=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.full_name,pakistan_real_estate_contacts.full_name),
    job_title=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.job_title,pakistan_real_estate_contacts.job_title),
    authority_level=CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.authority_level='unknown' THEN pakistan_real_estate_contacts.authority_level ELSE EXCLUDED.authority_level END,
    email=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email,pakistan_real_estate_contacts.email),
    phone=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone,pakistan_real_estate_contacts.phone),
    linkedin_url=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.linkedin_url,pakistan_real_estate_contacts.linkedin_url),
    source_url=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.source_url,pakistan_real_estate_contacts.source_url),
    confidence=greatest(pakistan_real_estate_contacts.confidence,EXCLUDED.confidence),
    is_decision_maker=pakistan_real_estate_contacts.is_decision_maker OR EXCLUDED.is_decision_maker
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT id FROM lead LIMIT 1) AS lead_id,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead) THEN 'upserted' ELSE 'skipped' END AS status,
  COALESCE((SELECT business_name FROM lead LIMIT 1),(SELECT business_name FROM input_data)) AS business_name,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM valid_business_emails) AS valid_email_count,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM contacts) AS contacts_upserted;

SELECT
  l.id,
  l.business_name,
  l.city,
  l.province,
  l.address,
  l.phone,
  l.website,
  l.domain,
  l.google_maps_url,
  l.rating,
  l.review_count,
  l.category,
  l.search_keyword,
  array_to_string(l.emails, '; ') AS emails,
  l.ai_score,
  l.ai_grade,
  l.ai_qualification,
  l.ai_nurture_strategy,
  l.whatsapp_confirmed,
  l.whatsapp_capable,
  array_to_string(l.whatsapp_numbers, '; ') AS whatsapp_numbers,
  l.conversion_tier,
  l.meta_crm_fit,
  l.social_activity_score,
  l.first_seen_at,
  l.last_seen_at,
  coalesce(
    string_agg(
      concat_ws(' | ',c.full_name,c.job_title,c.authority_level,c.email,c.phone,c.linkedin_url),
      ' ;; ' ORDER BY c.is_decision_maker DESC,c.confidence DESC
    ) FILTER (WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL),
    ''
  ) AS decision_makers
FROM pakistan_real_estate_leads l
LEFT JOIN pakistan_real_estate_contacts c ON c.lead_id=l.id
GROUP BY l.id
ORDER BY l.conversion_tier ASC,l.ai_score DESC,l.city,l.business_name;
